# The Brain-gated e2e tier retires once no Engine spec needs the bridge

## Context

@tobiu, 2026-11-06, verbatim: "NL is split to the engine side (processing arriving tool calls), and the brain side: bridge and tool definitions. both sides on their own can get tested inside each repo (we already do this). a full e2e cycle: i can not see any reasonable way, that is not heavy hitting on CI."

The Brain-gated tier (`test-e2e-brain.yml`) is that full cycle. Every Engine run of it checks out the Brain and drives Neural Link specs through the Brain's bridge. In #20328's baseline it holds 66% of Engine CI runner-minutes. Discussion D#18775 already chose the replacement: an off-socket adapter, so that Neural Link specs drive the page's own App Worker with no bridge and no Brain checkout. #20370 owns that track:
- dedicated-worker adapter: merged in #20372 / #20373;
- selection: #20374;
- SharedWorker apps: #20376.

## The Problem

None of those leaves removes the tier itself. Without a retirement task, the workflow, the Brain checkout and the Brain-only selection code would stay after their last spec moves. That is the pattern this morning's rule forbids: logic needs a task that uses it and then retires it.

## The Fix

Once #20374 and #20376 have landed:
- Every Neural Link spec that still needs the bridge is either ported to the off-socket adapter or retired with its reason. The Brain tests its own bridge and tool definitions.
- Delete `.github/workflows/test-e2e-brain.yml` and the classifier's Brain outputs: `e2e_brain_tier`, plus `e2e_brain_paths`, `e2e_brain_matrix` and `e2e_brain_shards` from #20411. Delete the `brain` branch of `tierSelection()` and `FULL_SHARDS.brain` with them.
- Delete the Brain-only selection and receipt code in `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` (`BRAIN_*`, `brain*` functions) and the exclusion in `test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs`, together with their specs.
- Remove any remaining Brain checkout from Engine workflows.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No Engine workflow checks out `neomjs/neo-agent-brain`. A `git grep` over `.github/workflows` shows it, with a control.
- [ ] Every Neural Link spec runs off-socket in the engine tier, or stays local with a written reason. At `dev` `b2f505e6e3`, `selectExternalBrainSpecs` gates 71 of 209 e2e specs. By the markers in their source:
  - 46 drive windows;
  - 4 hold multi-writer Bridge sessions (`bridgePort`, `waitForSession`);
  - 2 import Brain services (`loadNeuralLinkModules`);
  - 19 carry no marker: #20461's three residuals, plus 16 first candidates.
  - **The window rule was policy, not a capability limit.** The adapter forwards every window tool (Euclid, 11-08), and an app's popups share its SharedWorker. A local off-socket probe of the 42 window-driving files ran 37 clean, `workstation/WorkstationFilmTourNL` among them. #19919 folded in here: its hop 4 refusal was classified as film-harness timing.
  - **Outcome (PR #20584).** 54 specs join the engine tier:
    - the 16 candidates;
    - 36 of the 37 clean window specs;
    - the residuals `WorkstationNestedColumnResizeNL` and `WorkstationMaximizeTabOverflowNL`.

    The 37th, `WorkstationFilmTourNL`, runs off-socket but flaked hosted. One throw in four carried no momentum (474 of 960 px), so it is a declared `EXCLUSIONS` entry owned by #20593.

    The other 16 are declared in `LOCAL_ONLY` (`buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs`) with their reasons, and the selection floor refuses a Neural Link spec that sits in neither list. The 16:
    - 4 Bridge specs;
    - 6 Brain-service specs;
    - 6 window specs that fail on the adapter and pass over the Bridge, owned by #20587. One of them is the residual `DockSplitterZoneIdNL`, which fails off-socket after a re-boot.
- [ ] The Brain-only selection, receipt and exclusion code is deleted together with its specs. The deletion commits carry `spec-retired:` accounts.
- [ ] Engine CI runner-minutes per PR drop measurably against #20328's baseline.

## Moving a spec into the engine tier

- It joins `ADAPTER_ELIGIBLE_SPECS` and leaves `LOCAL_ONLY`, and it joins `RUN_PATHS` wherever its directory is not listed whole. The selection floor fails otherwise.
- `e2eEngineDurations.json` rebuilds through `--engine-durations`. A file the table has not measured counts at the median.
- `e2e-engine` is a required context, so a moved spec needs a hosted green first.
- Later moves ship under their own tickets (#20587).

## Out of Scope

- The off-socket adapters themselves (#20370, #20374, #20376).
- Brain-side bridge and tool-definition tests, which belong to the Brain repository.

### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-11-06T17:18:16Z

**The 16 unmarked specs already run off-socket locally.** (Grace, 2026-11-06, `dev` `268b527d30`.)

I added the 16 specs this body lists as the first candidates to `ADAPTER_ELIGIBLE_SPECS` in a throwaway worktree, with `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` unset, and ran them through the e2e config with `--retries=0`. Result: **47 tests passed in 2.8 min.** The config's notice dropped from 70 to "54 of 207 spec files are EXCLUDED", so all 16 ran in the Engine-only project, without a Bridge or a Brain checkout.

That is one local run, not admission. Following #20461's pattern, admission needs:
- `RUN_PATHS` entries for the 12 specs outside its directories: the 9 Workstation specs, `list/AnimateMembershipNL`, `rendering/NativeSelectNL` and `rendering/NestedComponentsNL`. Without them, `assertSelectionFloor` fails, or the Workstation specs fall into the GPU class and lose hosted coverage.
- Hosted green for the 9 Workstation specs, since `e2e-engine` is a required context and hosted runners cannot composite the Workstation's animated OffscreenCanvas work.
- Repeat runs before admission, as #20461 measured its residuals.

Timing: this lands after the 13.4 cut. A test-infra PR that adds specs to the required tier tonight would compete for the 20 runner slots and could redden every PR during the cut.
